instruction.text: You will hear an opinion about the relationship between social media use and mental health. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.
instruction.sound: You will hear an opinion about the relationship between social media use and mental health. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.

hint.text: Bei dieser Aufgabe musst du auf Details achten. Lies dir zunächst in Ruhe alle Statements durch und überlege dir, welche Begriffe eine zentrale Rolle spielen. Das hilft dir dabei, genauer hinzuhören.
hint.label: Listening for detail

atoms.sound: Yesterday, I listened to a podcast about the consequences of using social media. There was a lot of talk about mental health issues. The topic really resonated with me, as my sister suffers from severe social anxiety. Since she got a smartphone, everything has got much worse. Therefore, I suspect that their social media consumption did have an effect. However, I think the current debate about age limits for social media use misses the point. It would be more important to regulate how the platforms themselves work.

b: ++The speaker talks about her thoughts on a podcast she listened to.
Her sister suffers from attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
++The speaker sees a connection between smartphone use and mental health.
She misses a debate on the protection of minors.
++Social media companies should be better regulated.

instruction.text: You will hear an opinion about the rising cost of rent. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.
instruction.sound: You will hear an opinion about the rising cost of rent. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.

atoms.sound: Living in my tiny flat with rent that is too high, makes me wish our politicians would take housing affordability more seriously. It’s absurd to see rent rising faster than ordinary people’s incomes. This situation creates constant uncertainty and makes it hard to plan for the future, save money, or feel secure in your own home.  That’s why I support rent control. I believe housing investment is a major cause for rising rent and gentrification. Politicians need to realise how hurtful it can be for residents and local communities.

b: He believes he is paying a fair amount of rent.
++He wants politicians to take rental and housing issues seriously.
++The speaker claims that rent is rising faster than people's income.
++The rising rent is creating an insecure living situation.
The speaker believes housing investment is important for his community.

instruction.text: You will hear an opinion about health care debt in the US. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.
instruction.sound: You will hear an opinion about health care debt in the US. Tick all statements that correctly reflect what has been said. Multiple answers may be correct.

hint.text: Collections means a company, not your doctor or hospital, contacts you over unpaid bills and makes you pay them back. This can also affect your credit rating.
hint.sound: Collections means a company, not your doctor or hospital, contacts you over unpaid bills and makes you pay them back. This can also affect your credit rating.
hint.label: collections

atoms.sound: I was reading this study and it really shocked me how many people are stuck with medical debt, even when they have insurance. About 36 percent of households in the US have medical debt. Also, the study said stuff like paying bills over time or getting sent to collections is super common. And then I remembered that time I had to pay off a medical bill over a whole year because my insurance just didn’t cover it—so it suddenly felt very real.

b: ++The speaker read a study on medical debt in the US.
The speaker says that medical debt is rare and mostly affects people without any health insurance.
++The study claims that paying bills over time and collections are very common.
The study attributes medical debt entirely to people irresponsibly avoiding payment plans.
++The speaker's insurance does not cover all his medical bills.
